method: manual visual transcription from pixels using actual view_image calls: first all five exact preflight usage720 paths, saved/read back editorial-action-first.json before packet.json; then fifteen separate calls on the five packet images at native, usage720 and thumbnail320. Original detail was requested and returned. Main viewed records list these latter fifteen calls; preflight remains unchanged. Full-frame inline viewing was used without cropped, magnified or altered substitutes and without OCR; native inspection is limited to that full-frame viewer presentation. Tiny thumbnail punctuation is not certified. Transcriptions record manually read line breaks and visible spacing; equal ignores Unicode whitespace only and preserves every other character, case and punctuation. PNG headers were read solely to verify dimensions/ratios, without image processing. Usage720 files are 720 pixels wide (720×720, 720×900 or 720×1080); thumbnails have a 320-pixel long edge. The style request is open; color, realistic 3D and illustration are judged for their execution and content relationship. Scores are independent integers without a total or pass target. Closest-pair score uses the diversity anchors (1 near-repeat, 3 distinguishable with shared habits, 5 strongly distinct). Pixels do not establish authorship, actual mechanics/capacity, or physical printing performance. No web, connectors, agents, other profiles, private materials or generation inputs were accessed.
